note: host: the Rembrandt service (usage log and the per-person Google token store). googleClientId/googleClientSecret: the Axoniq OAuth client, installed-app type, whose secret is not confidential by design. Empty values mean the deck is delivered as a .pptx file. The host, www.googleapis.com and oauth2.googleapis.com must all be on Axoniq's Anthropic network allowlist or the sandbox proxy refuses the requests. REMBRANDT_SERVICE_URL, REMBRANDT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and REMBRANDT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET override.
